name: About Modal
description: Version/credits modal dialog. Displays Cockpit IDE branding, app version, Electron major version, Node major version, and a clickable 'UseDesign.md' link that opens in browser. Shows runtime versions from window.electronAPI.versions. Accepts optional onClose callback on open(). Overlay click and Escape key close the modal. Frameless — simple display panel.

interface.constructor: () — Creates overlay div (modal-overlay class, display:none), builds about-modal DOM with COCKPIT IDE branding, version specs (VERSION/ELECTRON/NODE/STYLE rows), close button, and design.md link. Reads versions from (window as any).electronAPI?.versions. Registers click listeners: close button → close(), design-link → shell.openExternal(), overlay click → close(). Appends overlay to document.body.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Stores optional onClose callback, sets overlay display:flex, registers Escape keydown listener to trigger close()

methods.name: close
methods.description: Sets overlay display:none, removes Escape keydown listener, fires stored onClose callback, nulls callback

lifecycle.destroyed_by: Lives for the duration of the renderer process, overlay element stays in DOM (toggled via display)
